title: Timed admission with a scoped lock
summary: Give callers a deadline for acquiring an exclusive slot and release it automatically when work exits.
triggers: exclusive access to a scarce resource within a deadline
timed mutex and RAII lock release after exceptions
prompts: Let a request wait briefly for the only renderer and decline to run it if the deadline has passed.
Make the same renderer available to the next caller after a render throws.
invariant: Rendering runs only while the caller owns the slot. The lock is released when its guard leaves scope, including during stack unwinding.
mantra: Try by the deadline, hold through use, release on exit.
pitfalls: A timed lock may return late or fail spuriously. The clock check rejects a late acquisition before calling the renderer.
The deadline applies to admission. A render that must finish by a deadline needs its own timeout or cancellation.
Timed mutexes leave caller order unspecified. Calling this method recursively on the same slot is invalid.
